title: HUD lane guidance and appreciated improvements
summary: This topic combines a complaint about lane guidance being limited to the HUD with undetermined remarks appreciating the HUD and wanting less cabin noise.

negative.summary: The negative feedback says showing lane guidance only in the HUD feels like a poor design choice.

limitations: The topic mixes at least two different subjects, HUD feedback and cabin noise, so the examples do not form a single coherent issue.
